## Evidence for
- [Study of Phase Coherence of Molecular Orientations in Coherence Domains of Water by Dynamic Molecular Simulation](https://waterjournal.org/volume-12/dolveck/): This paper discusses the properties of spatial phase coherence of molecular orientations in coherence domains in water through dynamic molecular simulation.
- [Quantum Coherence Meets Biological Health — QED Water, Coherence Domains, and the Terrain Model at Cellular Resolution](https://hewettinsite.substack.com/p/ah-vir-087-quantum-coherence-meets): This paper presents a body of peer-reviewed science developed by Emilio Del Giudice and Giuliano Preparata over four decades.
- [Water, The Cradle of Life via its Coherent Quantum Frequencies](https://waterjournal.org/current-volume/geesink/): This paper addresses the QED consideration that pure water has a phase of coherent standing waves that can be described through a coherent quantum entanglement function and the GM scale.

## Evidence against
- [Exclusion Zone Water: Separating Empirical Findings from Vitalist Interpretations](https://jthorvaldur.github.io/papers/pdfs/ez-water-coherence.pdf): This paper discusses the hypothesis that QED coherence domains of diameter ∼100nm exist in liquid water at room temperature and suggests a protocol for verifying this hypothesis using small-angle neutron scattering (SANS).
- [Meta-analysis Geesink and Meijer: healthy and unhealthy related...](https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Meta-analysis-Geesink-and-Meijer-healthy-and-unhealthy-related-electromagnetic_fig5_340488204): This paper discusses the role of non-coherent modulations of MW waves in health and disease, suggesting that coherent frequencies modulated with incoherent frequencies show an unhealthy behaviour.
- [Electromagnetic Frequency Patterns that are Crucial for Health and Disease reveal a Generalized Biophysical Principle: the GM scale](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/321169214_Electromagnetic_Frequency_Patterns_that_are_Crucial_for_Health_and_Disease_reveal_a_Generalized_Biophysical_Principle_the_GM_scale): This paper discusses the classification of all systems on a continuous spectrum of resonant complexity and reflexive capacity, suggesting that the framework dissolves the artificial boundaries between life and non-life, matter and mind.

## The single most decisive experiment
The most decisive experiment would be the small-angle neutron scattering (SANS) protocol proposed in [Exclusion Zone Water: Separating Empirical Findings from Vitalist Interpretations](https://jthorvaldur.github.io/papers/pdfs/ez-water-coherence.pdf), which aims to verify the hypothesis that QED coherence domains of diameter ∼100nm exist in liquid water at room temperature.

## Honest Verdict
The evidence for and against the claims about water coherence domains and the Geesink-Meijer frequency pattern is mixed. While there is some peer-reviewed literature supporting the existence of coherence domains in water and the potential impact of electromagnetic frequencies on health, there are also credible critics and alternative interpretations that question these claims. The most decisive experiment, the SANS protocol, would provide critical evidence to validate or refute the hypothesis of QED coherence domains in water. Based on the available information, my confidence in the claims is 0.5.
